title.en: Power in an AC circuit: the power factor
title.kn: ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮಂಡಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ: ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ

hook.en: Factories are charged extra for a low *power factor*. A current can flow, heat the supply lines and yet deliver almost no useful power. Such a current is called wattless.
hook.kn: ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಕು. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಹರಿದು ತಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಸಿಮಾಡಿದರೂ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಬಹಳ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರಬಹುದು. ಅದನ್ನು ವ್ಯಾಟ್‌ರಹಿತ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: Find the average power in an AC circuit using the power factor.
Explain wattless current and why the power factor is improved.

say.en: Factories are charged extra for a low power factor. A current can flow, heat the supply lines and yet deliver almost no useful power. Such a current is called wattless. In this lesson: Find the average power in an AC circuit using the power factor.
Explain wattless current and why the power factor is improved.

body.en: For $v = v_m\sin\omega t$ and $i = i_m\sin(\omega t + \phi)$, the *average power* is $P = VI\cos\phi$ (V and I rms). cos φ is the power factor, equal to R/Z in a series LCR circuit. Pure resistor: cos φ = 1, P = VI. Pure L or C: φ = ±π/2, so P = 0 even though current flows: a wattless current. At resonance, cos φ = 1.
body.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ P = VI cosφ; cosφ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ = R/Z. ಶುದ್ಧ L ಅಥವಾ C ನಲ್ಲಿ φ = π/2, P = 0: ವ್ಯಾಟ್‌ರಹಿತ ಪ್ರವಾಹ. ಅನುನಾದದಲ್ಲಿ cosφ = 1.

points.en: Pure L or C: P = 0 (wattless current)

narration.en: Average AC power is V I cos phi, where cos phi, the power factor, equals R by Z. A pure inductor or capacitor draws a wattless current, with zero average power.
narration.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ P = VI cosφ; cosφ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ = R/Z. ಶುದ್ಧ L ಅಥವಾ C ನಲ್ಲಿ φ = π/2, P = 0: ವ್ಯಾಟ್‌ರಹಿತ ಪ್ರವಾಹ. ಅನುನಾದದಲ್ಲಿ cosφ = 1.

say.en: Average AC power is V I cos phi, where cos phi, the power factor, equals R by Z. A pure inductor or capacitor draws a wattless current, with zero average power. P equals V rms I rms cos phi.
say.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ P equals VI cos phi; cos phi ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ equals R over Z. ಶುದ್ಧ L ಅಥವಾ C ನಲ್ಲಿ phi equals pi /2, P equals 0: ವ್ಯಾಟ್‌ರಹಿತ ಪ್ರವಾಹ. ಅನುನಾದದಲ್ಲಿ cos phi equals 1.

say.en: cos phi equals R over Z.
Pure L or C: P equals 0 wattless current.
Resonance: cos phi equals 1.

title.en: On the board: power and power factor

narration.en: When i lags v by φ, the instantaneous power p = vi is sometimes negative: energy flows back to the source. Averaged over a cycle, P = V_rms I_rms cos φ. cos φ is the power factor, and it equals R/Z. A pure resistor has cos φ = 1; a pure inductor or capacitor has cos φ = 0, so its current is wattless; at resonance cos φ = 1 again. Example: 220 V rms, 5 A rms and φ = 60° give P = 220 × 5 × 0.5 = 550 W. A low power factor means a large current and more line loss for the same power, so factories add capacitors to bring cos φ close to 1.

say.en: When i lags v by φ, the instantaneous power p = vi is sometimes negative: energy flows back to the source.
Averaged over a cycle, P = V_rms I_rms cos φ. cos φ is the power factor, and it equals R/Z.
A pure resistor has cos φ = 1; a pure inductor or capacitor has cos φ = 0, so its current is wattless; at resonance cos φ = 1 again.
Example: 220 V rms, 5 A rms and φ = 60° give P = 220 × 5 × 0.5 = 550 W.
A low power factor means a large current and more line loss for the same power, so factories add capacitors to bring cos φ close to 1.

When i lags v by phi, the instantaneous power p equals vi is sometimes negative: energy flows back to the source. Averaged over a cycle, P equals V rms I rms cos phi. cos phi is the power factor, and it equals R over Z. A pure resistor has cos phi equals 1; a pure inductor or capacitor has cos phi equals 0, so its current is wattless; at resonance cos phi equals 1 again. Example: 220 volts rms, 5 A rms and phi equals 60 degrees give P equals 220 times 5 times 0.5 equals 550 watts. A low power factor means a large current and more line loss for the same power, so factories add capacitors to bring cos phi close to 1.

title.en: Power factor: where the power goes

narration.en: The orange curve is the power p = v × i at each instant. When the current is out of step with the voltage by φ, part of each cycle sends energy back to the source. The average power is Vrms Irms cos φ; cos φ is the power factor.
narration.kn: ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ: ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ಲೈಡರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ, ಓದುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

caption.en: The orange curve is the power p = v × i at each instant. When the current is out of step with the voltage by φ, part of each cycle sends energy back to the source. The average power is Vrms Irms cos φ; cos φ is the power factor.
caption.kn: ಕಿತ್ತಳೆ ವಕ್ರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಷಣದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ p = v × i. ಪ್ರವಾಹ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್‌ಗಿಂತ φ ಹಂತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾಗ ಚಕ್ರದ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಆಕರಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ Vrms Irms cos φ; cos φ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ.

say.en: The orange curve is the power p equals v times i at each instant. When the current is out of step with the voltage by phi, part of each cycle sends energy back to the source. The average power is Vrms Irms cos phi; cos phi is the power factor.

body.en: Motors and other inductive loads draw current that lags the voltage, so cos φ is low. The line must then carry a larger current I = P/(V cos φ) for the same *power*, and the I²R loss in the lines grows. Connecting a suitable capacitor in parallel supplies the reactive (wattless) part of the current locally, raising cos φ towards 1.
body.kn: ಮೋಟಾರ್‌ಗಳಂತಹ ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಹೊರೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಕ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Low cos φ ⇒ larger line current for the same *power*

narration.en: Inductive loads like motors have a low power factor, so the supply must send more current for the same power. A capacitor connected in parallel cancels the lagging part and raises the power factor.
narration.kn: ಮೋಟಾರ್‌ಗಳಂತಹ ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಹೊರೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಕ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Inductive loads like motors have a low power factor, so the supply must send more current for the same power. A capacitor connected in parallel cancels the lagging part and raises the power factor. Low cos phi so larger line current for the same power.
say.kn: ಮೋಟಾರ್‌ಗಳಂತಹ ಪ್ರೇರಕ ಹೊರೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಕ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಅಂಶ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Larger I squaredR line loss.
Parallel capacitor raises cos phi.

caption.en: Normalised voltage, current and power p = vi when the current is out of phase by φ. Only the cos φ part of V_rms I_rms is real power.

problem.en: A series circuit has R = 30 Ω, X_L = 80 Ω and X_C = 40 Ω on a 200 V rms supply (so Z = 50 Ω and I = 4 A). Find the power factor and the average power.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A series circuit has R = 30 Ω, X_L = 80 Ω and X_C = 40 Ω on a 200 V rms supply (so Z = 50 Ω and I = 4 A). Find the power factor and the average power.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A series circuit has R equals 30 ohms, X L equals 80 ohms and X C equals 40 ohms on a 200 volts rms supply (so Z equals 50 ohms and I equals 4 A). Find the power factor and the average power.
cos phi equals R over Z equals 30 over 50 equals 0.6.
P equals VI cos phi equals 200 times 4 times 0.6 equals 480 watts.
Check: P equals I squaredR equals 16 times 30 equals 480 watts.
So the answer is Power factor 0.6; 480 watts.

problem.en: A motor draws 10 A from a 230 V supply at a power factor of 0.8. Find the power it uses, and the current it would need at a power factor of 1.

answer.en: 1840 W; 8 A at unity power factor

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A motor draws 10 A from a 230 V supply at a power factor of 0.8. Find the power it uses, and the current it would need at a power factor of 1.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A motor draws 10 A from a 230 volts supply at a power factor of 0.8. Find the power it uses, and the current it would need at a power factor of 1.
P equals VI cos phi equals 230 times 10 times 0.8 equals 1840 watts.
At cos phi equals 1: I equals P over V equals 1840 over 230.
I equals 8 A.
So the answer is 1840 watts; 8 A at unity power factor.

body.en: Only the part of the current in phase with the voltage, I cos φ, carries power. The part I sin φ, at 90° to the voltage, is wattless.

narration.en: Wattless means 90°. Only the part of the current in phase with the voltage, I cos φ, carries power. The part I sin φ, at 90° to the voltage, is wattless.

say.en: Wattless means 90 degrees. Only the part of the current in phase with the voltage, I cos phi, carries power. The part I sin phi, at 90 degrees to the voltage, is wattless.
